ptr=c_void_p; d=c_double; i=c_int
surface=api('cairo_image_surface_create',ptr,i,i,i)(0,1,1)
ctx=api('cairo_create',ptr,ptr)(surface)
select=api('cairo_select_font_face',None,ptr,c_char_p,i,i)

class Ext(Structure):
 _fields_=[(a,d) for a in ['x_bearing','y_bearing','width','height','x_advance','y_advance']]
extents=api('cairo_text_extents',None,ptr,c_char_p,POINTER(Ext))
class Header(Structure): _fields_=[('type',i),('length',i)]
class Point(Structure): _fields_=[('x',d),('y',d)]
class Data(Union): _fields_=[('header',Header),('point',Point)]
class CPath(Structure): _fields_=[('status',i),('data',POINTER(Data)),('num_data',i)]
copy=api('cairo_copy_path',POINTER(CPath),ptr)
free=api('cairo_path_destroy',None,POINTER(CPath))

 select(ctx,family.encode(),0,int(bold)); size(ctx,font_size); newpath(ctx)
 e=Ext(); extents(ctx,text.encode(),byref(e))
 if tracking is None:
  move(ctx,x,y); textpath(ctx,text.encode())
 else:
  for ch in text:
   move(ctx,x,y); textpath(ctx,ch.encode()); ce=Ext(); extents(ctx,ch.encode(),byref(ce)); x+=ce.x_advance+tracking
 p=copy(ctx); a=p.contents.data; n=0; cmds=[]
 while n<p.contents.num_data:
  typ=a[n].header.type; length=a[n].header.length
  if typ==3: cmds.append('Z')
  else:
   cmd={0:'M',1:'L',2:'C'}[typ]
   cmds.append(cmd+' '.join(fmt(z) for j in range(1,length) for z in [a[n+j].point.x,a[n+j].point.y]))
  n+=length
 free(p)
 return ' '.join(cmds), e
for family in ['Noto Serif','Noto Serif Display']:
 for weight in [False,True]:
  _,e=outline('Halyard',family,96,0,0,weight)
  print(family,weight,[(a,getattr(e,a)) for a,_ in Ext._fields_])

outline('32 px','Noto Sans',10,112,250); fill(ctx)
drawmark(112,260,1)
outline('64 px','Noto Sans',10,208,250); fill(ctx)

exec(open('/tmp/halyard-burgee-work/build.py').read().split('for family in')[0])
import re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
curve=api('cairo_curve_to',None,ptr,d,d,d,d,d,d)
line=api('cairo_line_to',None,ptr,d,d)
close=api('cairo_close_path',None,ptr)
fill=api('cairo_fill',None,ptr)
source=api('cairo_set_source_rgb',None,ptr,d,d,d)
scale=api('cairo_scale',None,ptr,d,d)
translate=api('cairo_translate',None,ptr,d,d)
save=api('cairo_save',None,ptr); restore=api('cairo_restore',None,ptr)
paint=api('cairo_paint',None,ptr); rule=api('cairo_set_fill_rule',None,ptr,i)
write=api('cairo_surface_write_to_png',i,ptr,c_char_p)
def rgb(h): return [int(h[j:j+2],16)/255 for j in (1,3,5)]
def path(d):
 tokens=re.findall(r'[A-Za-z]|[-+]?(?:\\d*\\.\\d+|\\d+)',d)
 at=0; x=y=0; cmd=None
 while at<len(tokens):
  if tokens[at].isalpha(): cmd=tokens[at]; at+=1
  assert cmd in 'MLCHVZ',cmd
  if cmd=='Z': close(ctx); cmd=None; continue
  n={'M':2,'L':2,'H':1,'V':1,'C':6}[cmd]
  values=list(map(float,tokens[at:at+n])); at+=n
  if cmd in ['M','L']:
   x,y=values; (move if cmd=='M' else line)(ctx,x,y)
   if cmd=='M': cmd='L'
  elif cmd=='H': x=values[0]; line(ctx,x,y)
  elif cmd=='V': y=values[0]; line(ctx,x,y)
  elif cmd=='C': curve(ctx,*values); x,y=values[-2:]
def element(el,inherited='#000000'):
 save(ctx)
 for name,args in re.findall(r'(translate|scale)\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)',el.get('transform','')):
  vals=list(map(float,re.split('[ ,]+',args)))
  if name=='translate': translate(ctx,vals[0],vals[1] if len(vals)>1 else 0)
  else: scale(ctx,vals[0],vals[1] if len(vals)>1 else vals[0])
 color=el.get('fill',inherited)
 if el.tag.endswith('path'):
  newpath(ctx); path(el.attrib['d']); source(ctx,*rgb(color)); rule(ctx,1 if el.get('fill-rule')=='evenodd' else 0); fill(ctx)
 for child in el: element(child,color)
 restore(ctx)
for file,mult in [('logo.svg',2),('mark.svg',.5),('mark.svg',8)]:
 root=ET.parse(file).getroot()
 assert not list(root.iter('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}text'))
 width,height=int(root.get('width')),int(root.get('height'))
 surface=api('cairo_image_surface_create',ptr,i,i,i)(0,int(width*mult),int(height*mult))
 ctx=api('cairo_create',ptr,ptr)(surface)
 source(ctx,*rgb('#FAF7EF')); paint(ctx); scale(ctx,mult,mult); element(root)
 target=f'/tmp/halyard-burgee-work/{file[:-4]}-{mult}.png'
 assert write(surface,target.encode())==0
 print(file, 'valid, self-contained SVG;',len(list(root.iter('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}path'))),'paths; rendered to',target)
